_note: Pinned model manifest for the M1+M2 strict model set (one-click bootstrap reads this file for local presence checks - see scripts/bootstrap.ps1 Test-ModelsPresent). v0.4.16: the LLM entry was REMOVED from the auto-download set - the ONE AND ONLY LLM is Qwen3.6 35B A3B IQ4_XS (operator-placed GGUF, ~19 GB, tested source hf.co/bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF:IQ4_XS, NO fallback profile). It may live on ANY drive: select it with the web UI 'LLM model' picker (config/llm_model.json) or scripts/find_qwen_gguf.ps1 (-SetEnv), or place it at models/llm/qwen3.6-35b-a3b/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-IQ4_XS.gguf. The file is never auto-downloaded and never copied into the project. . pinned_revision 'main' tracks the repo default branch; replace it with a full commit SHA for strict reproducibility - the resolved revision is recorded into INSTALL_MANIFEST.json by scripts/write_install_manifest.py after the download. snapshot=true means a full repo snapshot (the '(full repo snapshot)' files marker is kept for backward compatibility with older tooling); presence is probed via snapshot_probe plus a total-size floor (min_total_mb). Tools are GitHub release binaries installed into bin/ by scripts/install_m1.ps1 (step 11); pins must stay in sync with the variables at the top of that script. The M2 emotion entry (emotion2vec+ base) and the M3 speaker entry (speechbrain ECAPA) are CPU-only and optional at runtime - a missing emotion model degrades the pipeline to M1 behaviour, a missing speaker model to M1/M2 (fixed user_id), never blocks startup.

Hungarian; transformers ParakeetForTDT >= 5.6; loaded by app/asr_parakeet.py through the app/asr_core.py engine registry - asr_engine default 'parakeet'). The 6 transformers runtime files are downloaded (the repo's parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.q8_0.gguf is a llama.cpp artifact, NOT needed by the transformers path - skipped). pinned_revision = the exact HF commit the v0.6.0 gate ran against (MODEL_REGISTRY revision 541d1f99c6b0). v0.6.0 HOTFIX (v0.6.1, field report 'start.bat: asr still qwen, the NVIDIA model never downloads'): this entry said Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-0.6B - Qwen3-ASR was RETIRED from production in v0.6.0 (repetition garbage on valid speech, root-caused), but the delivery manifest was never migrated, so the bootstrap kept checking/downloading the qwen dir and parakeet was NEVER fetched; the runtime then failed with ASR_MODEL_LOAD_ERROR 'Unrecognized processing class' on the README-only placeholder. The retired models/asr/qwen3-asr-0.6b directory (if present from an older install) is left in place untouched - it is never auto-downloaded and never loaded by the production path (app/asr.py is the marked non-production migration module).
